notablePrerequisites:
You control a Treasure token.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {2}.
Repeat.
